posts.title: Your app already has a voice interface. It just can't hear yet.
posts.description: You don't need a new interface or a chat tab. The screens you already have can learn to listen. We've started calling that voice-permeable.

posts.title: The rule that didn't hold
posts.description: My long Claude Code sessions kept running past the handoff rule I pasted into them, so I built Stu. My cost per PR then fell by three quarters. Then I measured how much of that was Stu.
